items.title: GIGABYTE Expands Its Local AI Portfolio with the Launch of AI TOP AERO Powered by NVIDIA RTX SPARK™
items.summary: GIGABYTE today announced the launch of AI TOP AERO, a new AI desktop powered by the NVIDIA RTX Spark platform. Positioned as a Personal AI Studio, AI TOP AERO combines an NVIDIA Blackwell architecture GPU, up to 128GB of unified system memory, and GIGABYTE's cooling and compact chassis design. The new desktop expands GIGABYTE's AI PC lineup, bringing local AI development, content creation and gaming to personal workspaces.

items.title: Verint Appoints Abhi Sharma as Chief Product and Technology Officer
items.summary: MELVILLE, N.Y., November 10, 2026--Verint® today announced the appointment of Abhi Sharma as chief product and technology officer (CPTO), a newly created role uniting product and technology under a single leader. Sharma brings decades of experience leading and scaling global technology organizations.

items.title: 28th China Hi-Tech Fair to Open November 26, Bringing Together Global Technology Leaders
items.summary: Shenzhen,China, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The 28th China Hi-Tech Fair (CHTF), hosted by the Shenzhen Municipal People's Government and organized by Zhenwei Exhibition Group, will take place from November 26 to 28 at the Shenzhen World Exhibition & Convention Center (Bao'an). Preparations for the Global Procurement Matchmaking Conference are progressing smoothly, with major international companies confirming their participation and procurement needs becoming clearer across key industries.

items.title: Why Bernstein says Oracle AI opportunity is more valuable than previously thought
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bernstein reiterated its Outperform rating and $325 price target on Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) shares in a note on Tuesday, telling investors that the company’s economics are better than it previously thought after updating its 10-year model.

items.title: Druva Expands AI Resilience to Recover AI Agents Across the Enterprise
items.summary: SANTA CLARA, Calif., November 10, 2026--Druva, the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, today announced Druva Agent Recovery, a new set of AI Resilience capabilities that keep the business running by quickly restoring AI agents when they are deleted or unexpectedly changed. Support begins with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft’s platform for building custom AI agents.

items.title: Bay Emerges From Stealth With $50M After Fortune 100 Companies Used Its Platform to Triple Autonomous AI Agent Use
items.summary: TEL AVIV, Israel, November 10, 2026--Bay, the AI security platform building the trust layer for agentic enterprises, today emerged from stealth less than a year after its founding with dozens of enterprise customers, including Micron, Peloton, ClickUp and Wix. Bay addresses a primary barrier to AI adoption by allowing autonomous agents to perform business-critical work safely while enterprises retain control and accountability at scale.
